headline: Meeting declared void over wrong-body posting; all agenda items to return at next meeting.
summary: This document is an agenda, not minutes. It states that the meeting notice was posted for the wrong public body on the Secretary of State website, so the meeting is considered void. All agenda items will be addressed again at the next meeting.
